title: 第1097章 月无光第1096章 全力一战
lines: 仅存的五位修罗族强者怒吼，他们知道这一枪的代价是，敌不死，便是暗月亡。
这是最后拼命的招式。
“轰轰轰轰！！！”
毁天灭地的能量自星空中炸开，每一击都足以彻底的毁灭一个大陆。护罩剧烈的波动，仅仅支撑了数息之后，便是轰然破碎。
血色的战枪贯穿了敌人的识海！
暗月疲累的放下战枪，这一战她赢了，她的气息开始如同潮水一般的衰退。只要等她恢复，无需全部恢复，只要恢复一部分，战局就会彻底逆转。
苏牧的身影突然出现，“暗月大人，这一枚极品疗伤神丹，可以助你快速恢复伤势。”
暗月接过玉瓶，打开瓶塞，一股药香逸散开来，果然是神级丹药，来不及多想，暗月就准备将丹药送入嘴中。
就在这一瞬间，她身后的空间突然裂开了一道缝隙，一柄匕首刺入了她的后脑当中，她的双眼陡然睁大。
竟然还有一位刺客！一位九重巅峰的刺客竟然隐忍到了最后的一刻才出手。
她的美眸缓缓闭上，嘴角轻轻蠕动着，“羽儿，师尊不能再陪着你闯荡仙界了。”
暗月的手松开，玉瓶掉落的瞬间，苏牧一把抓住了玉瓶，愣在了原地。
刀锋拔出时带出一丝血线。
萧羽的心彻底撕裂了，有一种痛叫做痛彻心扉。
那一丝血线，就仿佛这世间最无解的诅咒，缠绕在萧羽的九彩道心之上。
无穷无尽的杀意蔓延开来，戮神之上的黑焰在星空当中蔓延开来。
刺客的惊恐的在空间不断的跳跃着，可是黑焰腐蚀的速度实在是太快了。
“这是什么？为何可以腐蚀空间？！”
刺客的一条腿在接触到黒焰的瞬间便是消失，他被逼出空间隧道的瞬间，萧羽便是出现在他的身前，单手扣在了他的头颅之上。
五指用力，红白之物破碎！
“薇拉！算无缺！我不管你们用什么方法，给我保住我师尊的命！”识海世界当中，萧羽压抑而疯狂的声音响起。
薇拉抱着暗月，心中一痛。
“无缺阁主，她的魂散了！”薇拉哭道。
算无缺双目一凝，“带她进血炼大阵！”
“主上！我要强者的神魂！越多越好！”算无缺双手挥动急切的道，他不知道能不能救回暗月，但是现在他必须尽全力，减缓暗月神魂的消散，否则等神魂散尽，就真的无力回天了。
萧羽心头一震，还有希望！
他转过头看向正在和三大星域大战的天境强者，眼中全是杀意！
“他在那里！”
虚空中，传来波动，正是追赶萧羽而来的张道升和顾北桥等人。
萧羽的身影骤然消失，再次出现的时候已经来到了剑无名身边，识海世界开启，穆罗的身影出现，“无名！穆罗！等下这里交给你们！”
丢下这样一句话，萧羽便是一刀向着围攻三大星域的天境强者斩落！
“血海浮屠卷！”
一座巨大的画面铺展开来，卷入其中的强者，发出凄厉的惨叫！
“噬灵！”
血丹极速的旋转，很多强者还活着，神魂便是被一百零八座浮屠抽取，凄厉的惨叫声让毛骨悚然。
“来了！”算无缺伸手一抓，上百道强者的神魂便是被他握在手中。
“还不够！”
算无缺的声音响起。
content_en:
The five remaining strong men of the Shura clan roared angrily. They knew that the cost of this shot was that if the enemy was not killed, Dark Moon would die.
This is the last desperate move.
"Boom boom boom boom!!!"
Heaven-destroying energy exploded from the starry sky, and each blow was enough to completely destroy a continent. The shield fluctuated violently, and after only supporting it for a few breaths, it suddenly shattered.
The bloody battle spear penetrated the enemy's sea of ​​consciousness!
An Yue put down her battle gun tiredly. She won this battle, and her aura began to decline like a tide. As long as she recovers, there is no need to recover completely, as long as she recovers part of it, the situation of the battle will be completely reversed.
Su Mu's figure suddenly appeared, "Lord Dark Moon, this top-quality healing pill can help you recover from your injuries quickly."
An Yue took the jade bottle and opened the cork, and a scent of medicine spread out. It was indeed a god-level elixir. Before she could think about it, An Yue was about to put the elixir into her mouth.
At this moment, a gap suddenly opened in the space behind her, a dagger pierced the back of her head, and her eyes suddenly widened.
There is an assassin! An assassin at the peak of the ninth level actually held back until the last moment before taking action.
Her beautiful eyes slowly closed, and the corners of her mouth twitched slightly, "Yu'er, Master can no longer accompany you to explore the fairy world."
An Yue's hand let go, and the moment the jade bottle fell, Su Mu grabbed the jade bottle and froze on the spot.
There was a trace of blood when the blade was pulled out.
"Master!!!"
Xiao Yu's heart was completely torn, and there was a kind of pain called heart-breaking pain.
That trace of blood was like the most unsolvable curse in the world, entangled in Xiao Yu's nine-color Taoist heart.
"Die!!!"
Endless killing intent spread, and the black flames above the God of Killing spread in the starry sky.
The assassin kept jumping in the space in fear, but the black flame corroded too fast.
"What is this? Why can it corrode space?!"
"Ah!"
The assassin's leg disappeared the moment it came into contact with Black Flame. The moment he was forced out of the space tunnel, Xiao Yu appeared in front of him and clasped his head with one hand.
With five fingers, the red and white things shattered!
"Vera! It's all right! I don't care what method you use, just save my master's life!" Xiao Yu's suppressed and crazy voice sounded in the world of Consciousness Sea.
Vera hugged Dark Moon and felt a pain in her heart.
"Pavilion Master Wuque, her soul is gone!" Vera cried.
Suan Wuque's eyes narrowed, "Take her into the blood refining formation!"
"Lord! I want the souls of the strong! The more the better!" Zhan Wuque waved his hands and said eagerly. He didn't know if he could save Dark Moon, but now he must do his best to slow down the dissipation of Dark Moon's soul. Otherwise, when the soul is gone, there will be no way to save it.
Xiao Yu was shocked, there was still hope!
He turned his head to look at the Heaven Realm experts who were fighting against the three major star regions, his eyes full of murderous intent!
"There he is!"
Fluctuations came from the void, it was Zhang Daosheng, Gu Beiqiao and others who were chasing Xiao Yu.
Xiao Yu's figure suddenly disappeared, and when he reappeared, he was already at Jian Wuming's side. The world of Consciousness Sea opened, and Muro's figure appeared, "Wuming! Muro! I'll leave this to you later!"
After saying such a sentence, Xiao Yu slashed at the Heaven Realm experts who were besieging the three star regions with one strike!
"Blood Sea Pagoda Scroll!"
A huge picture spread out, and the strong man involved in it let out a shrill scream!
"Eating Spirits!"
The blood pills rotated extremely fast, and many strong men were still alive, but their souls were extracted from the one hundred and eight pagodas. The screams were horrifying.
"Here it comes!" Suan Wuque stretched out his hand to grab it, and the souls of hundreds of powerful men were held in his hands.
"Not enough!"
The perfect voice sounded.
title_en: Chapter 1097 Moonless Chapter 1096 Fight with all your strength
